messages:
maria (Finance): flagging PulseLabs invoice INV-2026-0912 — customer says a developer voucher (DEV-VOUCH-2026) was meant to apply to their staging tests but looks like it never did. invoice jumped ~$32k overnight. can we triage?

tonya (CS): saw a support ticket. they ran a load run on 2026-04-11 expecting staging to be covered. voucher was issued by AE Claire on 3/29, expiry set to 4/15. customer attached screenshot of voucher code in their portal.

liam (Billing): pulling the billing rule now. quick check: voucher DEV-VOUCH-2026 exists but scope = "new-accounts-only" in promo_rules table. Looks like it was created with wrong scope.

claire (AE): omg sorry team, I asked for a simple dev voucher but must have selected the wrong template. I have the original email thread to the customer proving intent to cover staging.

maria (Finance): okay — technical root cause = misconfigured promo rule. Business ask = customer wants credit for staging run (estimate $32,450). recommend: issue manual credit for full amount as goodwill since AE committed coverage. Need Nate signoff for credits >$25k. Also want a ticket to change promo_rules governance.

billing-bot: voucher DEV-VOUCH-2026 status: ACTIVE; rule_scope: new-accounts-only; expiry: 2026-04-15; last_modified_by: claire.

nate (RevenueOps): agree to help keep account happy. Approve one-time manual credit of $32,450. Conditions: (1) create credit memo referencing INV-2026-0912; (2) mark GL 4-2100-credits; (3) capture AE thread to FIN-5032 for process fix.

liam (Billing): creating adjustment -> ADJ-2026-4020. Credit memo CM-2026-188 created and linked to INV-2026-0912. Posting GL 4-2100-credits. Moving to AR pending release upon confirmation.

claire (AE): uploaded my email thread and the customer screenshot to the support ticket. apologies team 61e.

maria (Finance): please also run a scoped audit for other vouchers created with the wrong scope in March. Add to FIN-5032. We should avoid repeating this.

liam (Billing): ran quick query: found 3 vouchers with unexpected scopes created 2026-03-25..2026-03-31. Logging as part of FIN-5032.

billing-bot: adjustment ADJ-2026-4020 recorded by liam. Audit ref: CM-2026-188. FIN-5032 created and assigned to billing-platform.

tonya (CS): customer notified: "We've applied a one-time credit while we fix the voucher. We'll follow up with process changes." they said thanks and will confirm when invoice reflects credit.

maria (Finance): closing note: release AR hold after AE evidence confirmed and FIN-5032 remediation planned. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
